_comment: ABMCTSBackend = AB-MCTS-A (Adaptive Branching MCTS, node-aggregation variant), from Sakana AI's 'Wider or Deeper?' (arXiv:2503.04412 / sakana.ai/ab-mcts, OSS: SakanaAI/treequest), as a gama backend. gama's 5th composite mode: an inference-time SEARCH that, at every node, Thompson-samples whether to spend the next model call GOING WIDER (a fresh candidate) or GOING DEEPER (refining an existing one), driven by the external `verify` score as the reward. Each worker is one bandit action, so on a 'go wider' step it also learns online WHICH model to call = Multi-LLM AB-MCTS. Fill ssh_host. Works for BOTH `gama run "<task>" --config examples/abmcts.example.json --task-type code_implementation` AND `gama bench --backends abmcts,ssh-openai --config examples/abmcts.example.json --tier large` (bench threads each case's checker in as the reward, so the search is measured on the same check it scores with). The win to look for: matching a single strong model with a budget of small-model calls — structure, not scale. Honest control: compare against a width-only best-of-N (an `ensemble` of the same worker) to prove the adaptive search actually pays.
